claycode.finding: Keep executable operators closed and explicitly precedence-typed; use registry-gated typed n-ary PredicateIR/ConstraintIR for declarative relations; three legacy rules require SEMANTIC_FREEZE_REQUIRED rather than guessed normalization.

frank.finding: No FRANK-specific relation syntax is justified. FRANK requirements may select needed semantics but do not authorize ambiguous source normalization or external effects.

clayresearch.finding: Supports BASE less-change-more-compile: fix frontend ownership/typed IR boundaries before adding cognitive primitives.

claygraph.finding: Typed n-ary relation signatures align with current hyperrelation role semantics; relation identity/arity must be resolved before graph mutation or projection, while activation remains non-authoritative.

unifieddb.finding: Semantic relation identity/signature/hash can be persisted independently from work/effect authority; this delta does not imply physical database consolidation.

gwt.finding: NO_CHANGE: parser/predicate identity does not constitute broadcast, use, effect, outcome or re-entry evidence.

hyperposition.finding: Typed n-ary PredicateIR is compatible with higher-order relation representation; alternatives/conflicts must remain explicit rather than collapsed by precedence guesses.

emergenz.finding: NO_CHANGE: deterministic parsing/normalization is not evidence of causal emergence.

harness.finding: Treat the three ambiguous legacy rules as compile/freeze blockers. Differential fixtures should reject them until authoritative expected IR is bound, then verify roundtrip identity and non-expansion of authority.
